text:
Noah Rivera: heads-up: qbringup on new q6b-int4 shows precision regression on our paraphrase rerank bench. dropping about 6 points vs int8 baseline on short prompts. wondering if this is tokenizer-related or quant mapping.
Aisha Gomez: saw that in the dashboard. is the failure concentrated by locale or by prompt length?
Noah Rivera: mostly short prompts (<=64 tokens) and lots of punctuation-heavy inputs. sample ids attached below.
Noah Rivera: ```
samples: ["ps-99211", "ps-99222", "ps-99245"]
metric: precision@10 0.88 -> 0.82
model: q6b-int4-canary
```
Kenji Sato: can we do a curation pass to pull paraphrase golden candidates and check dedupe collisions? might be tokenization merging some punctuation tokens differently under new tokenizer config.
Tess (labeler): we can run a small manual curation. what's the label schema? rank correctness + is_duplicate flag?
Noah Rivera: yes rank correctness (1-3) and duplicate flag. Also note if the output is semantically equivalent but tokenized differently. target: 50 paraphrase pairs + 20 controls.
Aisha Gomez: I'll spin an automated edgecase sampler to prioritize punctuation and multi-sentence short prompts. tagging as paraphrase-punc-edge.
ci-bot: created task paraphrase-punc-edge-401 with 70 items; assignees: @Tess (labeler), @Aisha Gomez. deadline: 72h.
Kenji Sato: quick experiment idea: try remap table that preserves punctuation tokens as separate ids before quant mapping. small kernel change but could help. I'll prototype and run a micro-eval.
Tess (labeler): starting batch now. quick Q: if two outputs are equivalent but use different variable names, mark same meaning?
Noah Rivera: yes mark same meaning. only flag reject if semantics differ or answer misses crucial element.
Kenji Sato: prototype run queued: `./bench/remap_eval.sh --model q6b-int4-canary --remap punctuation-sep --subset paraphrase-punc-edge`. will post results.
Aisha Gomez: also recommend locking this canary from traffic and adding a routing hold. I'll update catalog.
Noah Rivera: done, hold set. will open a short GH issue linking the ci run and label batch.
Kenji Sato: micro-eval results: precision@10 improved to 0.86 with remap but still below baseline. saving diffs at /artifacts/q6b-int4-canary/remap-diffs.tar.gz
Tess (labeler): assigned and started. ETA 36h for first pass. flagging a few ambiguous pairs, will ping for adjudication.
Aisha Gomez: great. after labels we'll run microgolden ab test (n=15) and see whether to adjust per-layer scale or token remap permanently.
Noah Rivera: summary: paraphrase edge batch launched, prototype remap shows partial recovery, canary held from traffic. will reconvene after labels.
